title: Njem Nlegharị Anya nke Naanị Ya
intro: N'akwụkwọ akụkọ amara Chineke, e nwere mkpụrụ obi dị ọcha na-enweghị atụ, nke e kewapụrụ iche n'etiti ndị ha iji chọọ ịnọ naanị ha n'akụkụ dị nsọ. Ha amaghị na ịnọpụ iche a ga-eweta ihe ịrịba ama maka ụwa niile, ọnwụnwa nke okwukwe nke a ga-ekwu maka ya ruo mgbe ebighị ebi.
clues: E tinyere m onwe m n'ọrụ ijere ozi tupu amụọ m.
E tinyere m n'okpuru nlekọta nke onye amụma dị ebube.
E nyere m ihe oriri sitere n'aka Allah nke tụrụ onye nlekọta m n'anya.
E si n'ezinụlọ m pụọ gaa n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ.
Mmụọ ozi pụtara ìhè n'ihu m n'ụdị nwoke zuru oke, na-eweta ozi banyere nwa nwoke dị ọcha.
Mgbe m lọtara na nwa amụrụ ọhụrụ m, ndị obodo m boro m ebubo, mana nwa amụrụ ọhụrụ ahụ kwuru okwu iji gbachitere m.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
